assembly.action: Join top guard rails between movable side posts. Seat pickets in side base rails, then lower each post/top-rail subassembly onto the picket and post-foot tenons.
assembly.scope: Nominal subassembly sequence; lifting rig, temporary bracing, tolerances and structural erection plan remain unverified.

assembly.action: Preassemble front guard panels and entry posts, then bring the two side bents together along X around the front panels. Do not fix both bents before engaging the transverse tenons.

Seat the six centered brace post-end tenons. Preassemble the two roof beams with the front header, then lower this U-shaped assembly onto all four post heads and the brace-head tenons; fit their transverse pegs.
Lower the transverse roof ties into their open top half-laps and fit their pegs.

Preassemble and peg each rafter pair at its apex half-lap. Lower the paired rafters onto their open birdsmouth seats before installing the deck, cedar and flashing. Rafter uplift restraint remains a design requirement.

verification.scope: Nominal housed guard/post/header joints, face-housed 2x6 braces, roof half-laps and birdsmouth seats; capacity and erection engineering unverified.
